description: This horizontal stacked bar chart illustrates the evaluation matches between an LLM judge and human annotations across 300 samples for six different criteria. The vertical category axis lacks an overall label and lists the categories from top to bottom in the following order: "No Hallucination", "Oriented", "Active", "Self-aware", "Rigorous", and "Correct". The horizontal value axis also lacks an overall label but utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0% to 100%, with percentage tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 20%. Each category is represented by a single horizontal bar stacked to span the full 100% width of the chart, divided into two color-coded segments as defined by an inset legend: a darker blue left segment representing "Matched" and a lighter blue right segment representing "Not Matched". Every bar segment contains an explicit numerical annotation of its exact percentage. For the "Matched" (darker blue) segments, values range from a minimum of 94.00% in the "Self-aware" category to a maximum of 99.00% in the "Correct" category. Conversely, the "Not Matched" (lighter blue) segments range from a minimum of 1.00% for "Correct" to a maximum of 6.00% for "Self-aware". The remaining categories display values of 98.33% matched and 1.67% not matched for "No Hallucination", 97.33% matched and 2.67% not matched for "Oriented", 97.00% matched and 3.00% not matched for "Active", and 95.33% matched and 4.67% not matched for "Rigorous". The bars are not sorted in strict numerical or alphabetical order, and visual emphasis is provided by the numerical percentage annotations centered within each respective color segment.
